project.positioningZh: 以武汉大学校园完整度、准确度和细节还原为优先的水下数字重建项目。
project.positioningEn: An underwater digital reconstruction prioritizing the completeness, accuracy, and architectural detail of Wuhan University.

coordinateSystem.originDescriptionZh: V2 工程临时原点，仅用于建立资产与场景管线，不对应官方测绘坐标。
coordinateSystem.originDescriptionEn: Temporary V2 engineering origin used for the asset pipeline; it is not an official surveyed coordinate system.

zones.nameZh: 珞珈山历史建筑核心区
zones.descriptionZh: 老斋舍、樱顶、百步梯、老图书馆与 912 操场相关空间。
zones.descriptionEn: Old Dormitories, Cherry Blossom Castle, Hundred-Step Stairway, Old Library, and the 912 sports field context.

zones.descriptionZh: 牌坊、入口道路、林荫道及其与校园内部的连接关系。
zones.descriptionEn: The archway, entrance roads, tree-lined approach, and connections into the campus.

zones.descriptionZh: 行政楼、理学楼及邻近教学建筑的工程分区。
zones.descriptionEn: Engineering zone for the administration building, science hall, and adjacent academic buildings.

zones.nameEn: East Lake Edge and Fengyuan Precinct
zones.descriptionZh: 东湖岸线、枫园教学与生活空间、湖滨道路及景观设施。
zones.descriptionEn: East Lake shoreline, Fengyuan academic and residential spaces, lakeside roads, and landscape facilities.

zones.nameZh: 校园道路与公共空间网络
zones.nameEn: Campus Circulation and Public Space Network
zones.descriptionZh: 樱花大道、主要道路、步行系统、公共设施与后续全校园扩展框架。
zones.descriptionEn: Cherry Blossom Avenue, primary roads, pedestrian routes, public amenities, and the future whole-campus framework.

places.notesZh: 应完整重建跑道、草坪、看台、挡土墙、出入口、周边高差与历史建筑视线关系。当前尺寸和位置仅用于工程测试。
places.notesEn: The reconstruction should include the track, field, stands, retaining walls, entrances, elevation changes, and sightlines to the heritage buildings. Current dimensions and position are engineering placeholders.

places.nameEn: Old Dormitories and Cherry Blossom Castle
places.notesZh: 已建立台地、分层宿舍翼楼、连接廊、屋顶亭阁与程序材质结构粗模；整体比例、坐标和细部仍需测绘与多源核验。
places.notesEn: A structured blockout now includes terraces, layered dormitory wings, bridges, rooftop pavilions, and procedural materials; overall proportions, coordinates, and details still require survey and multi-source verification.

places.notesZh: 已按公开资料建立108级结构粗模、两处平台和侧墙；踏步尺寸、真实坡度及上下建筑接口仍需现场核验。
places.notesEn: A 108-step structured blockout, two landings, and side walls are in place from public references; tread dimensions, true slope, and building interfaces still need field verification.

places.notesZh: 已建立台基、两翼、柱廊、角部圆顶、八角塔身和重檐结构粗模；比例、瓦作、石材和精确高度仍需图纸与测量校准。
places.notesEn: A structured blockout now includes the plinth, wings, colonnade, corner domes, octagonal tower, and layered roofs; proportions, roof work, stonework, and exact heights still require drawing and survey calibration.

places.notesZh: 应根据明确年代和版本建模，牌坊形制、柱体、横梁、屋顶、题字与周边道路不能混用不同时期资料。
places.notesEn: The selected historical version must be explicit; columns, beams, roofs, inscriptions, and surrounding roads must not mix references from different periods.

places.notesZh: 已建立中央体量、两翼、入口柱廊、三级台阶、窗洞节奏和分层屋顶结构粗模；坐标、比例和周边道路绿化仍待核验。
places.notesEn: A structured blockout now includes the central mass, wings, entrance colonnade, three stair terraces, window rhythm, and layered roofs; coordinates, proportions, roads, and planting remain unverified.

places.notesZh: 已建立主体、侧翼、入口柱廊、窗格、鼓座与穹顶结构粗模；穹顶曲线、立面材料和精确比例仍需进一步核验。
places.notesEn: A structured blockout now includes the main body, side wings, entrance colonnade, windows, drum, and dome; the dome profile, facade materials, and exact proportions still require further verification.

places.notesZh: 已沿统一道路骨架建立连续道路、两侧铺装、实例化樱花树、路灯、座椅及行政楼和理学楼前广场；道路宽度、树距、树种、设施位置和真实高差仍需地图与现场测量校准。
places.notesEn: A continuous blockout now follows the shared road spine with sidewalks, instanced cherry trees, lamps, benches, and plazas at the administration and science buildings; road width, tree spacing and species, furniture positions, and true elevation still require map and field calibration.

places.notesZh: 当前名称、具体建筑对象、年代和位置仍需核验，暂不得视为确定复原。
places.notesEn: The exact building identity, date, name, and position still require verification and must not yet be treated as a confirmed reconstruction.

places.notesZh: 需核验亭体形制、柱数、屋顶、台基、纪念信息、周围坡地与植被。
places.notesEn: Verify the pavilion form, column count, roof, plinth, memorial information, surrounding slope, and planting.

places.notesZh: 岸线必须建立在可追溯地图或地形数据上，当前仅标记需要处理的方向和范围。
places.notesEn: The shoreline must be based on traceable map or terrain data; the current object only marks the direction and approximate work area.
